Fixed an issue with the turnip puzzle
Minor tweaks and improvements to the Steam achievements

notes.title: The Mine: Steam Achievements Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[b]Exciting news for all miners! [/b]I can now announce that my Steam achievements for 'The Mine' are completed and ready for you to experience. There are 26 achievements in total, and although their names might hint at their challenges, I believe discovering how to achieve them will be part of the adventure. I have made minor tweaks to the gameplay to make the achievement more fun and fitting. This update also includes more bug fixes, aiming to make your gameplay experience even smoother.

[b]As for the future of the game[/b], including the story's conclusion and the possibility of adding new content or a Part 2. My decision will be based on players interests to make it happen, my current commitments and other factors outside my control, such as work obligations and managing all other responsibilities. While I'm considering the possibility of making this new content available for free for everyone who has already bought the game or considering to do so in the future, I want to keep expectations realistic and avoid making any promises at this stage. 

I hope you enjoy this update and encourage you to take it easy down in the mine!

Best // Fredrik

notes.title: Continuing the Journey: Updates and Insights from 'The Mine' Developer
notes.content:
[b]A huge thank you to everyone who has played 'The Mine' [/b]so far and shared their valuable opinions about the game. I'm deeply grateful for the honesty and constructiveness of your feedback. Some of you have provided insights on the game's ending, and I want you to know I'm taking these comments to heart. Currently, I'm exploring the most appropriate and feasible ways to address this feedback. Additionally, I'm in the process of implementing [b]Steam achievements[/b], which is currently in development and nearing completion. This feature has been highly requested by many of you and will be available soon.

[b]My ultimate goal is for 'The Mine' to live up to your expectations[/b], considering the resources and time I have. The importance of this endeavor isn't lost on me, and I assure you, I'm not taking any decision lightly. I'll continue to keep you informed about the game's development and the decisions regarding its future. Your support is invaluable to me, and I'm committed to making sure that the time and passion I've invested in this project are well spent, enriching both your experience and mine.

Best // Fredrik

notes.title: The Mine – Patch Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are all having a great time in Elsborg and enjoying your adventures down in The Mine! I'm excited to present my first update, which includes a mix of major and minor fixes, as well as some handy new features. Notably, you can now increase the font size in the dialogue box via the display options in the main menu.

[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] -Fixed a bug in the pub scene that caused the dialogue to freeze when interacting with Carl and Egold.
[*] -Resolved a dialogue issue with Sven on the platform, where some lines would appear at incorrect times.
[*] -Fixed an issue where certain unintended interface elements were occasionally appearing during gameplay.
[*] -Addressed a bug that prevented Anders' portrait from displaying correctly in the dialogue box.
[*] -Resolved a bug that caused two dialogues to play simultaneously when inspecting the moving horse cart.
[*] -It's now possible to open Mother's journal by dragging it from the inventory to the player character. Note: This does not work in the underground mining level due to technical reasons (right-clicking to open the journal remains functional on all levels).
[*] -Fixed an issue where copper coins could not be picked up.
[*] -Improvements have been made to the player character's mobility when crossing paths with the Bartender in the pub scene.
[*] -Overall improvements to the hint system
[/list]

[b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] -Added support for three different font sizes in the dialogue box, which can be changed under Main Menu > Options > Display.
[/list]

notes.title: Uncover History in 'The Mine' - Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]The day is here, 'The Mine' is released! [/b]It's been a long and fantastic journey, with both ups and downs. I could never have imagined how this would turn out when I, in the midst of a pandemic, sat down for the first time with Unreal Engine and began learning to code.

[b]I invite you[/b] to explore the 17th-century Swedish copper mines in 'The Mine', A game blending humor with a dive into historical depths. I hope the game brings you as much joy as it did to me while creating it.

Feel free to take a look and join my Discord: https://discord.com/invite/CgKvaubdMb .

I would also be very grateful if you, who have bought the game, take the time to review it here on Steam. It will be a great help for me and my continued development of potential sequels set in the same universe.

Happy exploring in 'The Mine' - remember to keep your torch lit in the dark depths!
